newsitem.title: USA: Selective Insurance storm losses $5.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Selective Insurance storm losses $5.3 mln.

text.p: Selective Insurance Group Inc said Thursday it expects losses from Hurricanes Fran and Bertha to reach about $5.3 million after reinsurance and before federal income taxes.

The losses are expected to reduce the company's third quarter net income by about $3.4 million, or $0.24 per share. In the same period in 1995 the company posted net income of $38.8 million, or $2.65 per fully diluted share.
The company said Hurricane Fran caused most of the losses in North Carolina and Virginia.
Selective Insurance is a holding company for five property and casualty insurance companies.
